title: Disappointing
text:
Disappointing. My and my wife's large hat collection keeps outgrowing available racks. This brings the total to five racks in this style (counting this one) from four different brands. Of them this is the only one that disappoints.

First, there were longitudinal cracks in three of the sections, although they are in no danger of separating.

Second, the legs are not as long or at the same angle as the other four racks I own.

I thought they were all made in the same factory and sold to different brands to put their own labels and sell them. Either I was wrong or my rack is a factory second. The finish is somewhat crude and uneven as well. Finally, there is a distinct varnish odor. Not overpowering, but none of the other racks that I own had that issue. In fact the other four, are perfect in design, fit and finish and are a lot more stable than this one. Stability is not paramount for my use since I am hanging hats and in a child-free environment.

I cannot recommend this rack and suggest that you consider one of the many almost identical brands offered here.
